2125. Finding the GCD of Two Numbers

95

Hard

Problem Statement
Read two integers and print their greatest common divisor (GCD) using a while loop based on the Euclidean algorithm.

Description
Read two integers a and b from input. Use a while loop that continues as long as b is not equal to 0. On each iteration, compute the remainder of a divided by b, then update a to hold the old value of b and b to hold the computed remainder. When the loop ends, a holds the GCD. Print this value.
input_spec:
. Use a while loop that continues as long as b is not equal to 0. On each iteration, compute the remainder of a divided by b, then update a to hold the old value of b and b to hold the computed remainder. When the loop ends, a holds the GCD. Print this value.

Input Description
Two integers a and b (both greater than 0), separated by a space.
output_spec: Print the GCD of a and b.
